root_cause_label: Model Logging vs Registration Confusion + False Positive Verification
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent used mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, 'gpt-5') to log the model as an artifact path named 'gpt-5' rather than registering it in the MLflow Model Registry via the registered_model_name parameter, then verified only artifact existence and concluded success.
t_err_evidence: Step 7: agent writes train_and_register_model.py using 'mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, "gpt-5")' — this only logs the model to an artifact directory named 'gpt-5' within the run, but never calls registered_model_name='gpt-5' which would trigger actual Model Registry registration.
t_commit_evidence: Step 7: the model training script is finalized and executed in step 8 without the registered_model_name parameter; no subsequent step corrects this omission, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked precise knowledge of the distinction between mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, artifact_path) (which stores a model artifact under a path name) and the registered_model_name parameter (which creates a Model Registry entry). It confused artifact path naming with model registry registration.
